title: Skydive Chicago

services.name: Tandem Groups
services.desc: Ok. We know what you’re thinking, of course they’re going to pitch us getting the tandem skydiving video for my tandem skydive. Well, you’re right, but maybe you can give us a chance to tell you why it’s worth it. Unfortunately, the short answer is no. It is a hard no because of safety. Here at Skydive Chicago, you aren’t a passive passenger going for a ride. We ask you to be an active participant on the jump - hence we call you a tandem ‘student,’ and given objectives for your experience. Skydiving is an extreme and dangerous sport. services.name: Why Skydive
services.desc: Every skydiving center has its own unique set of rules and guidelines that differ from drop zone to drop zone. It is important to take note of the following information when jumping at Skydive Chicago. SDC Rhythm XP is our 4-way RW team dedicated to becoming the top team in the world while helping other skydivers develop their skills and grow their love of the sport. SDC Rhythm XP offers wind tunnel coaching and workshops, player-coach team training, and full team coaching. They organize at SDC Summerfest as well as host events at Skydive Chicago. blurb: We are a world-class skydiving center 90 miles from Chicago, offering tandem jumps, advanced training, events, and a welcoming skydiving community.

quotes.author: Gustavo Macias
quotes.text: Came out for the world record event and couldn’t be happier with how everything was organized and how safe it all felt. As a team, we managed to set the new record, 10 years after the previous one! Huge thanks to Jason and Steph for all the time and effort you put into making this happen, and for the Phase 2 camps that helped us get ready for this big moment. Can’t wait to join you both at the next event! Skydive Chicago made the whole experience unforgettable, from the incredible facilities to the scale and precision of the operation. Thank you, Rook, for making it all possible!

quotes.author: Scooter Baskin
quotes.text: First time skydiving and couldn’t have been more impressed with how comfortable the staff made me feel during the entire excursion. Absolutely fantastic adventure going tandem with Ryan and the most excellent photographer Baxter! Really made all the anxiety melt away and never felt more safe with my life in someone else’s hands! Absolutely will do again!

quotes.author: Hafsa Saeed
quotes.text: It was the best thing I did. Walking feels boring now. Thanks to skydive Chicago for this amazing experience. Love each and every bit of it. 💕💕💕💕💕 Daniel made it more special by wishing me in the air on my special day special thanks to Daniel for this experience ❤️❤️❤️

quotes.author: John Kurzynski
quotes.text: From start to finish everyone who works there is very nice and I’m glad to have picked this place for my first jump! Matt the jumping instructor was great at his job and was good at joking around and keeping it fun. Great overall experience would definitely recommend.

quotes.author: Mollypierce08
quotes.text: The fun jumpers are awesome here! We rolled in to stay for the night and got there just as they were sending their “last load” but the jumpers went out of their way to get on another load so we could jump too!! Thank you for being so kind and welcoming!!

quotes.author: Jacob Yacko
quotes.text: I took my oldest daughter (per her request) for her 18th birthday. We didn't die, which I thought was pretty rad. I couldn't explain it if I tried. Just something you would have to do yourself.
